note: Roll table. Shapes: grid (die column + result column, assists.grid) and list ('<n>:' prose rows). Rows ship as r<lo>[-<hi>] sections; text stays lazy; formula via rollAt. Grid keepEmpty ships a blank die row as empty text; bands ([y0,y1] each) or centerDies (die centred in its cell) groups rows. details {by: number|name, regions} appends each row's explaining paragraphs, keyed by its die or name.
